message: I've had my share of tech hiccups, especially when I really need my phone or tablet—like when I'm trying to look up fire safety tips! That’s why I love finding solid resources that I can bookmark for when the moment strikes. This one’s from the NFPA and offers practical advice on home fire safety. It’s a good reminder to stay prepared even when our gadgets decide to take a break. What’s your go-to resource for staying safe at home?
